guestNote: We recommend always using SRS mode. Only use guest mode when you let someone else use your phone.
creditsNote: Fonts, sounds, poem data and open source.
creditsCardKanaBody: The kana on the torifuda cards are pre-rendered images made from the font A-OTF 正楷書CB1 Std by Morisawa Inc. The font itself is not bundled with this app.
creditsSoundsBody: Sound effects by Kenney (www.kenney.nl): Music Jingles, Impact Sounds and Interface Sounds. Released under CC0 — credit is not required, but we give it gladly.
creditsMusicBody: "fun bgm 022824" by syncopika (opengameart.org/content/fun-bgm-022824), converted to AAC (m4a). Licensed under CC BY 3.0 (creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/).
creditsPoemDataBody: Poem text and readings come from StoneLabs' hyakuninissyu-csv (github.com/StoneLabs/hyakuninissyu-csv), released under the Unlicense (public domain). The 百人一首 poems themselves are in the public domain.
creditsInspirationBody: Inspired by the Fudaotoshi app (jp.excd.fudaotoshi). Not affiliated with or endorsed by its developer.
creditsOpenSourceBody: Flutter, Dart and every package this app is built on.

languageNote: Menus and messages. Cards always stay in Japanese.
coachStartCard: First, the start card. Ready? Swipe it away!
coachKnowIt: A card! Say it out loud, “{0}”, and flick it away. Any way but straight down means “I know it”.
coachDontKnowHold: Now pretend you forgot it: swipe DOWN and HOLD until the ring fills. That means “I don't remember”. Peek top left — your last kimariji!
coachDontKnowButton: Now pretend you forgot it: tap “Don't remember” below. Peek top left — your last kimariji!
coachDontKnowOff: “I don't remember” is switched off in your settings, so just flick this one too! Peek top left — your last kimariji.
coachFast: Last one. As fast as you can!
coachDone: Perfect! Every swipe is timed to the millisecond. Now for real!
coachRetryKnow: Oops, that was “I don't remember”! Flick it sideways or up instead.
coachRetryHold: So close! Swipe down and keep your finger there until the ring fills.
coachRetryButton: This time, use the “Don't remember” button!
lockFirstIsland: Finish your first island to open {0}!
lockFinishedOne: Play 1 round to the last card to open {0}!
lockFinishedOther: Play {0} more rounds to the last card to open {1}!
tourWelcome: Welcome to 札飛ばし! I'm Tobi, your coach.
tourWhat: A 札落とし trainer: a card appears, you say its kimariji and flick it away, as fast as you can!
tourSrsJourney: My SRS (spaced repetition) picks what you practise and when, and unlocks new cards as you learn.
tourSrsKnown: My SRS (spaced repetition) decides what you practise and when, from your millisecond times.
tourTraining: That's 修行, your daily training! Tap it to try three practice cards.
tourMap: The 100 cards live on islands, grouped by first kana. Tap it to sail toward the next one!
tourIslandPlan: Your island and today's plan: new cards, reviews, and Learn ahead for more. Tap it to see!
tourRank: Your class and rating — they climb as your cards get faster. Tap it to check!
tourModes: 始める plays every card you know, once each; 苦手 drills your slowest ones. Tap here to try one!
tourGuest: Handing the phone to a friend? Tap here for Guest mode — it records nothing.
tourLevel: Your level: every swipe earns XP. Tap it for My Profile.
tourTabs: History, Stats and Help live down here — the ones in chains open as you play. Tap one to peek!
tourTabsOpen: History, Stats and Help live down here. Tap one to peek!
tourSettings: Settings: There are all sorts of options in here.
tourPracticeAgain: Come on, it's only three cards!
tourFinale: You're all set! Tap 修行 any time you like to start training for real.
replayTourNote: Tobi shows you around Home again.
